Leg 2 is two small undated-but-live supply risks: the 212.9M-share resale S-3 can be declared effective on any business day, and $83.2M of ATM room remains. Those sum to -1.5. The scaled number, -2.24, comes from abs_move 14 (the episode's own next-day moves were 14-41%; the 3-year median |next| is 9.39%) and p_up 42. p_up rests on the name's own record (5 of 6 continuations this episode, 35% up-rate over 34 falls) and is held near 50 by the <2x volume ratio, a crypto weekend and a meme float that can squeeze either way.

cause.what_happened: Today's -18% (all intraday, no gap) is the fifth straight leg of the unwind of a meme spike: about $0.86 in mid-September to $7.48 on 2026-10-02 and an intraday peak near $9.82 on 2026-10-05. The unwind was triggered by Fugazi Research's 2026-10-05 report calling SDEV 'uninvestable at any price above zero' (a SKY-token holder with no stablecoin business, and 167.5M pre-funded warrants unlocking in tranches with the next on 2026-10-16). No new company-specific news was found today; a 12:32 EDT wire item attributed the move to unspecific 'regulatory crackdowns on stablecoins' and to momentum.

findings.finding: The 212,876,259-share resale registration for R01, Framework, Tether and Sky Frontier (4.1x the 51.75M shares outstanding) is pre-effective as of Amendment No. 2, filed 2026-10-06. The company has agreed to use best efforts to make it effective, so it can be declared effective on any business day, including 2026-10-12.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Amendment No. 2 came three days ago and nothing on EDGAR shows effectiveness yet. An EFFECT notice or a 424B3 on Monday would be visible inside the window. This is a probability, not a scheduled date; I put roughly 20-30% on it landing by the 2026-10-12 close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None observed for effectiveness on this name. The 2026-10-05 fall, which leaned partly on Fugazi's dilution argument, was -47% followed by -17.5% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: The dilution argument is public, but the registration still blocks resale by the four holders. Effectiveness turns registered-but-unsellable shares into sellable ones, limited to 10% of 30-day ADV per purchaser and by the beneficial-ownership caps. A price that already held this would not keep slipping into each close on sub-2x relative volume.
findings.independence: Fugazi report via cryptobriefing (https://cryptobriefing.com/fugazi-research-sdev-stock-uninvestable/) makes the same dilution argument independently

findings.finding: About $83.2M of the $100M at-the-market program with Virtu Americas remained as of 2026-09-30. The company holds only $7.2M of cash and has said it has sold no SKY, so the program can sell stock into Friday's after-hours or Monday's session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An open ATM can be drawn in any session, including Monday's. Draws are not disclosed until the 10-Q or a prospectus supplement, so this lands as supply pressure rather than as a headline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM was set up in January 2026 (424B5 of 2026-01-20) and the February 2026 episode saw a cluster of continuation days (-18.1, -21.05, -21.43, -6.06 next-close). I cannot attribute those to ATM draws.
findings.why_not_priced: Whether the company used the spike to sell, and whether it keeps selling at $1.63, is not disclosed. After a 78% fall a draw is less attractive, which is why this is small. A price that held a finished ATM would show buyers absorbing bounces, and every one-day bounce this episode (+41% on 2026-10-01) was sold.
findings.independence: Cash of $7.2M and no debt at 2026-09-30, from the 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1389545/000143774926031972/sdev20260914_8k.htm), is the motive for drawing

outside_window.finding: Another 30% of the 167.5M January 2026 pre-funded warrants ($0.05 exercise) becomes exercisable on 2026-10-16 (the remaining 50% on 2027-01-16), subject to 4.99%/9.99% caps and a 10%-of-ADV daily sale cap.

On a fully diluted count (51.75M + 167.5M pre-funded warrant shares = 219.3M) against roughly $187M of SKY plus cash at 2026-09-30, NAV is about $0.85 per share, so $1.63 is still about 1.9x mNAV.
